arguments.command: cd $CLONE && ls tests | head -50; ls; cat TESTING.md 2>/dev/null | grep -n -i "run\|pytest" | head -20
cd $CLONE && find tests -type f | head -50; find tests -type f | wc -l; sed -n 1,80p CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | grep -n "tests/"
cd $CLONE && git status --short | head; git log --oneline -5; grep -rln "tests/fixtures" --include=*.rs --include=*.py --include=*.sh . 2>/dev/null | grep -v target | head
cd $CLONE && grep -n "uv run\|cargo\|pytest" CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | head -30; grep -rln "plan-relations\|doc-checks" --include=*.py --include=*.rs skills _shared yf 2>/dev/null | head
cd $CLONE && grep -rlE "tests/fixtures|\"fixtures\"|'fixtures'" --include=test_*.py --include=*.rs . 2>/dev/null | grep -v -e target -e docs/plans | head

cd $CLONE && grep -rlE "tests/fixtures|parents\[.\].*tests|\"tests\"" --include=*.py --include=*.rs . | grep -v -e target -e docs/plans; uv run --with pytest python3 -m pytest _shared/test_doc_lint.py -q 2>&1 | tail -30
